rca_of_the_issue: Previously, days_remaining calculation referenced today_d inside /api/presence without defining it in the function scope, so the try/except swallowed NameError and returned null. The fix anchors today_d to target_date, so live and historical presence views compute remaining leave days relative to the requested date. Regression coverage included required presence member keys for all 141 live members.
